description: Find a company's contact details and its owner from its website or a Google Maps place_id: published emails, phone numbers, social profiles (facebook, instagram, linkedin, x, tiktok, youtube, pinterest) and the contact page, plus the owner or founder's name and title with source_url, the page that names them. Use it after google_maps_search: pass each local result's place_id to turn a list of local businesses into leads. Returns data.company {name, website, domain, emails[], phones[], socials, contact_page, address, place_id}, data.owner {name, title, source_url, email, email_status} or null when no page names one, and data.pages_read[]. Provide url or place_id. 10 credits from a url, 20 from a place_id (1 when the listing has no readable website); a site that cannot be reached is free. Takes 10-45s.

place_id.description: A Google Maps place_id from google_maps_search. The listing is looked up first, then its website is read. 20 credits instead of 10.

url.description: The company's own website; a bare domain works. Not a social profile (that is a 400). Provide this or place_id.
